name: Letrozole
owner: generic (many); Femara brand held by Novartis

discovery.note: A triazole aromatase inhibitor optimised for potency and selectivity.

tagline: Potent aromatase inhibitor for breast cancer, also widely used to induce ovulation
summary: Letrozole is a potent non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor that suppresses oestrogen synthesis in postmenopausal women. It is used for adjuvant, extended adjuvant and metastatic treatment of hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer, often with CDK4/6 inhibitors, and off-label to induce ovulation in polycystic ovary syndrome.
mechanism: Letrozole binds the haem of aromatase (CYP19A1) through its triazole ring, inhibiting peripheral conversion of androgens to oestrogens by more than 95% and lowering plasma oestradiol.
In ovulation induction, a short course lowers oestrogen feedback on the hypothalamus and pituitary, raising FSH and promoting follicle development.
uses: Adjuvant treatment of hormone-receptor-positive early breast cancer in postmenopausal women
Extended adjuvant therapy after 5 years of tamoxifen
Advanced breast cancer (alone or with CDK4/6 inhibitors)
Off-label: ovulation induction in polycystic ovary syndrome

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Approved as Femara for advanced breast cancer after anti-oestrogen therapy.

history.title: MA.17
history.detail: Extended adjuvant letrozole after tamoxifen reduces recurrence; the trial is stopped early.

history.title: BIG 1-98
history.detail: Letrozole improves disease-free survival versus tamoxifen as initial adjuvant therapy.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic letrozole launches in the US.

history.title: PCOS fertility trial
history.detail: Legro et al. (NEJM) find letrozole produces more live births than clomifene in polycystic ovary syndrome.

history.title: With palbociclib
history.detail: Letrozole plus palbociclib receives accelerated approval for first-line advanced breast cancer.

pk.metabolism: hepatic CYP3A4 and CYP2A6 to an inactive carbinol

facts: Letrozole is not licensed for fertility treatment in most countries, but it is widely recommended for ovulation induction in PCOS.
